header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, KARACHI
Date Order with signature of Judge
Mr. Hafiz Safdar Nawaz, advocate for the applicants.
body: Though notice of this transfer application has been issued to the respondent No.1 on the same address as given in the cause title of the family suit pending between the parties, but the bailiff of the Court has not been able to serve him with such notice. The report seems to be dishonest and concocted. Let show cause notice be issued to the concerned bailiff to explain his position regarding non-service of notice of this transfer application on respondent Khalid Nazir. Such explanation should be submitted before the worthy Registrar of this Court within two weeks, who shall examine it and place before the undersigned for further consideration.

2. Through this transfer application under Section 25-A of the Family Court Act, 1964, applicants have sought transfer of Family Suit No.210/2005, stated to be pending before the Court of Vth Civil Judge & Judicial Magistrate, Karachi (South).

3. As desired by this Court vide its order dated 09.03.2009, comments to this transfer application have been received from the Presiding Officer of the said Court Mr. Muhammad Shujaat Mirza. A perusal of such comments reveals that in substance the Presiding Officer of the Court has shown his helplessness in disposal of the family suit, which has already remained pending before him since 7 th March, 2008, i.e., over one year. It is evident that during this one year no serious efforts were made by the Presiding Officer of the Court to ensure disposal of the family suit, which was by that time already ripe for final arguments. Such conduct of the Presiding Officer is sufficient to hold him inefficient and incapable in the performance of his duties.

4. Accordingly, looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I order transfer of Family Suit No.210/2005 from the Court of Vth Civil Judge & Judicial Magistrate, Karachi (South) to the Court of IXth Civil Judge & Judicial Magistrate Karachi (South) for disposal of case in accordance with law within one month from the date of communication of this order. A copy of this order be retained in the personal file of Mr. Muhammad Shujaat Mirza, Civil Judge & Judicial Magistrate for consideration by the Administration Committee at appropriate time.
